info.name: Websites
info.summary: Serve folders of Markdown files as websites — blogs, team sites and documentation with in-browser editing
info.description: Publish websites directly from Nextcloud folders: Markdown files are rendered with selectable themes (blog, team site, documentation), with in-browser editing for owners and collaborators. Sites are served at /remote.php/sites/{name} (or /sites/{name} with an opt-in web-server rewrite).
info.author: Frederik Orellana, DTU
